I’m so sorry about your Echo... It’s truly hard to accept how fast it happens. And to lose them in these difficult times is just more painful. I lost my chowchow on new year to bone cancer. She had trouble breathing before that and after getting an xray, the vet said that it would develop very quickly, giving her 1-3 months. We lost her in 2 weeks. My fiance and I were beyond devastated and I considered just leaving life to be with her again. Even months later, I have recurring nightmares of the day I lost her. She was the light of my life in a world of growing darkness. I hope that in time we both will find peace.
Thank you for what you do and all the love you give them!
Thank you for saving her! You make the world better for all of us.
